export declare const KIT_AGENT_DEFINITIONS_PROVIDER_ID = "system.agent-definitions";

export declare const KIT_AGENT_MCP_PROVIDER_ID = "system.agent-mcp";

export declare const KIT_AGENT_TOOLS_PROVIDER_ID = "system.agent-tools";

export declare const KIT_MCP_ACCESS_PROVIDER_ID = "system.mcp-access";

export declare const KIT_PACK_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_PROVIDER_ID = "system.kit";

export declare const KIT_READ_PERMISSION = "kit:read";

export interface KitCatalog {
    packs: KitPack[];
    entries: KitEntry[];
    issues: Array<{
        provider_id: string;
        title: string;
        message: string;
    }>;
}

export type KitCatalogListRequest = Record<string, never>;

export interface KitPack {
    pack_id: KitPackId;
    kind: "plugin" | "builtin" | "characters";
    name: string;
    description: string;
    source?: Extract<KitSource, {
        kind: "plugin";
    }>;
    version?: KitVersion;
    upgraded?: {
        from: string;
        to: string;
        at: string;
    };
    state: KitPackState;
    roles: Array<{
        role: KitEntryKey;
        prompts: KitEntryKey[];
    }>;
    skills: KitEntryKey[];
    mcp: KitEntryKey[];
    tools: KitEntryKey[];
    manage?: KitManageLink;
    export: {
        package: boolean;
        prompt_overrides: boolean;
        references: boolean;
    };
}

export interface KitPackFile {
    format: "molis.kit-pack";
    format_version: 1;
    exported_at: string;
    pack: {
        name: string;
        plugin_id?: string;
        version?: string;
    };
    package?: PluginPackageExport;
    prompt_overrides?: PromptOverridesFile;
    references: Array<{
        kind: KitKind;
        ref: Extract<KitReportedEntry, {
            ref: unknown;
        }>["ref"] | SkillRef;
        name: string;
        source_title: string;
        needs?: {
            connector_categories: string[];
        };
    }>;
}

export type KitPackState = {
    kind: "uninstalled";
} | {
    kind: "disabled";
} | {
    kind: "unknown";
    issues: number[];
} | {
    kind: "attention";
    items: Array<{
        entry: KitEntryKey;
        reason: string;
    }>;
} | {
    kind: "active";
};

export interface PluginPackageExport {
    plugin_id: string;
    version: string;
    publisher_key_id: string;
    filename: string;
    media_type: "application/json";
    content: string;
}

export interface PluginPackageExportRequest {
    install_id: string;
}

export declare const kitCatalogActions: {
    list: ActionDefinition<KitCatalogListRequest, KitCatalog>;
};

export declare const kitErrors: import("platform/action-errors").ErrorCodeRaisers<{
    readonly report_invalid: "invalid";
}>;

export declare const servicesKitContract: {
    readonly contractId: "io.molis.work.service.kit.v1";
    readonly kind: "service";
    readonly schemaVersion: 1;
    readonly maturity: "contract-only";
    readonly ssot: "specs/capability-pack/contract-design.md";
};
